# DELETE /api/v1/repos/{owner}/{repo}/issues/{index}/labels

Remove all labels from an issue

**Module:** [routers](../modules/routers.md) · **Auth:** bearer · **ID:** `ep-339`

## Request

| Param | Location | Type | Required |
|-------|----------|------|----------|
| owner | path | string | True |
| repo | path | string | True |
| index | path | integer | True |

## Response

- **403** — User lacks write permission on issues/pulls
- **404** — Issue not found
